body:
Cinematic wide-format cover illustration for "Inside Modern Semiconductors", subtitled "From wafer to package".
Theme: semiconductor manufacturing, robotic inspection, advanced packaging.
Visual approach: abstract geometric with clean modern lines.
Composition: strong central focal point, negative space in upper third for text overlay.
Color palette: deep navy transitioning to electric blue with warm amber accents.
Atmosphere: professional, aspirational, forward-looking, modern and aspirational sensibility.
Inspired by the article's core concepts, 
create a visually striking hero image with dramatic volumetric lighting,
fine detail textures, and cinematic depth of field.
Magazine-quality digital art with strong visual hierarchy., 8K, ultra-high-quality, masterpiece, cinematic composition, rule of thirds, volumetric lighting, dramatic shadows, fine detail textures, professional color grading, limited-ink risograph editorial illustration, one bold readable silhouette, one to three restrained spot inks on warm uncoated paper, solid ink shapes and one consistent halftone screen, subtle paper tooth, slight edge-only registration drift, intentional overprint, strong thumbnail hierarchy, avoid: rainbow palette, continuous gradients, glossy 3D, general blur, photographic texture, dense microcopy, invented text, logos, fake vintage stains, mixed watercolor or chrome effects
